movies.title: Half Light
movies.description: After the accidental death of her young son, novelist Rachel Carlson retreats to a remote coastal village hoping to recover and write again. She becomes close to lighthouse keeper Angus McCulloch, only to learn that the man she has been seeing is supposed to have died years earlier, leaving Rachel to determine whether she is being haunted, deceived or losing her grip on reality.

movies.title: Heaven Can Wait
movies.description: After his death, Henry Van Cleve arrives at the entrance to Hell convinced that his lifelong weakness for women has earned him admission. His Excellency is unconvinced, so Henry recounts his life, his marriage to Martha and the family complications surrounding them in an attempt to prove that he belongs downstairs.

movies.title: Holiday Engagement
movies.description: When Hillary Burns is dumped just before bringing her fiancé home for Thanksgiving, she cannot face another round of disappointment from her demanding family. She hires actor David to pose as the missing fiancé for the holiday weekend, but maintaining the lie becomes harder as David fits into the family rather better than the man he is replacing.

movies.title: In a World...
movies.description: Voice coach Carol Solomon lives in the shadow of her famous trailer-voice father Sam and survives on small recording jobs. When a coveted movie-trailer campaign opens up, Carol unexpectedly becomes a contender against both Sam and his protégé Gustav, turning a professional opportunity into a family collision.

movies.title: In Time
movies.description: In a society where people stop aging at twenty-five and time has become currency, factory worker Will Salas receives more than a century from a wealthy stranger and is immediately suspected of murder. After entering the privileged time zone and taking heiress Sylvia Weis with him, Will is pursued by Timekeeper Raymond Leon while the pair begin attacking the system that keeps the poor literally running out of life.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
movies.description: Indiana Jones learns that his estranged father Henry disappeared while searching for the Holy Grail. Following Henry's trail through Venice and into Nazi hands turns the archaeological hunt into a rescue mission, with father and son forced to work together before the Grail can be claimed by people with considerably worse plans for it.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
movies.description: Archaeologist Indiana Jones is sent to find the Ark of the Covenant before a Nazi expedition can obtain it. The search reunites him with Marion Ravenwood and puts him against rival archaeologist René Belloq as the trail moves from Nepal to Cairo and finally to the dangerous consequences of opening what they have been chasing.

movies.title: John Tucker Must Die
movies.description: Heather, Beth and Carrie discover that school basketball star John Tucker has been dating all three of them at once. They recruit new student Kate to help dismantle his reputation and engineer the heartbreak he usually leaves to other people, but the plan gets complicated when Kate becomes close to John's brother Scott.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.description: John Hammond invites paleontologists Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler, mathematician Ian Malcolm and his own grandchildren to inspect a nearly finished island theme park populated by cloned dinosaurs. When sabotage disables the park's security systems, the visitors are separated across the island and the attraction becomes a survival problem its designers never truly controlled.

movies.title: Just in Time for Christmas
movies.description: Psychology professor Lindsay Rogers is offered her dream academic job just as longtime boyfriend Jason proposes marriage. Unable to choose between leaving home and building a life with him, Lindsay meets a mysterious coachman who carries her three years into the future, where she can see what one version of that decision actually costs.

movies.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
movies.description: Captain Alexei Vostrikov is ordered to take command of the Soviet nuclear submarine K-19 from Captain Mikhail Polenin and rush the vessel through sea trials during the Cold War. When the reactor cooling system fails far from home, command rivalry becomes secondary to containing a nuclear disaster that could kill the crew and provoke a much larger crisis.

movies.title: Kate and Leopold
movies.description: Scientist Stuart Besser accidentally brings nineteenth-century Duke Leopold into modern New York through a time portal. Stuart's ex-girlfriend Kate initially treats Leopold as another problem created by Stuart, but the courtly visitor adapts to the present surprisingly well and the growing attraction between Kate and Leopold collides with the fact that history requires him to go home.

movies.title: King Kong
movies.description: Petrox executive Fred Wilson leads an expedition to an uncharted island in search of oil, carrying paleontologist Jack Prescott and rescued castaway Dwan with him. The island instead yields a gigantic ape worshipped as Kong, and Wilson's decision to capture the animal for publicity turns an already dangerous discovery into a catastrophe transported back to New York.

movies.title: King Solomon's Mines I
movies.description: After abandoning a mercenary safari partner whose brutality disgusts him, Allan Quatermain accepts an offer from Elizabeth Maitland to find her missing father in Africa. Dr. Maitland disappeared while pursuing the legendary King Solomon's Mines, and the expedition soon becomes a race involving the map, hostile rivals and forces seeking the treasure for themselves.

movies.title: King Solomon's Mines II
movies.description: Quatermain, Elizabeth Maitland and their companions push deeper into the expedition as the search finally reaches the territory surrounding King Solomon's Mines. Rival treasure hunters, tribal conflict and the dangers inside the mines turn the rescue of Elizabeth's father and the legendary riches into the same increasingly narrow path to survival.

movies.title: Leaving D.C.
movies.description: After two decades in Washington, D.C., Mark Klein moves alone to a remote house in West Virginia and sends video updates to the OCD support group he left behind. Strange nighttime sounds from the surrounding woods lead him to begin recording and measuring what happens outside, but each attempt to make the disturbances rational produces evidence that is harder to explain.

movies.title: Love Actually
movies.description: In the weeks before Christmas, a network of Londoners navigate marriages, new attractions, grief, betrayal and badly timed declarations of love. Their stories range from the newly elected Prime Minister's attraction to Natalie to Daniel helping his stepson Sam pursue a first crush, with the separate relationships gradually revealing how closely their lives overlap.

movies.title: Master and Commander
movies.description: Captain Jack Aubrey takes HMS Surprise after a powerful French privateer, turning a brutal first encounter into a long pursuit across two oceans. The chase tests Aubrey's duty to the mission, his responsibility to his crew and his friendship with surgeon Stephen Maturin.

movies.title: Me Before You
movies.description: Cheerful but directionless Lou Clark takes a job caring for Will Traynor, whose life changed completely after an accident left him quadriplegic. As Lou tries to draw him back into the world, their growing attachment collides with Will's firmly held plans for his own future.

movies.title: Minuscule
movies.description: A young ladybug is separated from its family and falls in with a colony of black ants carrying an abandoned box of sugar home. When rival red ants pursue the prize, the tiny journey turns into a full-scale siege fought across the forest floor.

movies.title: Miracle
movies.description: Coach Herb Brooks is given the task of building the 1980 United States Olympic hockey team from talented college rivals. His punishing methods are meant to turn them into one unit capable of facing the dominant Soviet team when the tournament reaches Lake Placid.

movies.title: Monsoon
movies.description: John survives the accident that killed his closest friend Sarah, but recovery leaves him trapped between grief and the life he was supposed to resume. A new relationship with co-worker Caitlyn forces him to confront the future he has been postponing and finally let Sarah go.

movies.title: Moon
movies.description: Near the end of a three-year solo contract mining helium on the far side of the Moon, Sam Bell begins suffering strange lapses and an accident outside the base. What he discovers afterward makes his employer's tidy version of his assignment increasingly difficult to believe.

movies.title: Much Ado About Christmas
movies.description: Kind-hearted heiress Haley meets romantic ad man Claud and lets him believe she comes from an ordinary background. The deception becomes awkward when Claud's biggest professional opportunity brings him directly to Haley's formidable mother just before Christmas.

movies.title: National Treasure
movies.description: Treasure hunter Benjamin Franklin Gates believes a trail left by America's founders points to a vast hidden fortune. When he learns that the next clue is concealed on the Declaration of Independence, he decides stealing the document may be the only way to keep it from a rival.

movies.title: Next Stop Christmas
movies.description: Successful surgeon Angie boards her usual commuter train before Christmas and unexpectedly arrives ten years in her own past. With a mysterious conductor controlling the route, she gets another look at the choices that shaped her career, her family and the relationships she left behind.

movies.title: Nick and Norah’s Infinite Playlist
movies.description: Recently dumped musician Nick and sharp-tongued Norah pretend to be a couple for a few minutes at a New York club, then spend the night searching for a secret concert and a missing friend. Their improvised partnership gradually becomes the real point of the evening.

movies.title: Oblivion
movies.description: Repair technician Jack Harper patrols an abandoned Earth, maintaining drones that protect the machines extracting the planet's remaining resources. A crashed spacecraft and the woman he rescues from it expose contradictions in his memories and in the mission he has been told is nearly complete.

movies.title: Peter Pan
movies.description: Peter Pan carries Wendy Darling and her brothers from London to Neverland, where children can fly and growing up seems optional. Their adventure among the Lost Boys, mermaids and Captain Hook becomes more complicated as Wendy and Peter discover they want very different things from childhood.

movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
movies.description: Blacksmith Will Turner joins unpredictable pirate Jack Sparrow after Elizabeth Swann is taken aboard the Black Pearl. The rescue becomes entangled with a stolen piece of Aztec gold and a curse that has left Captain Barbossa's crew unable to enjoy the treasure they fought to possess.

movies.title: Premonition
movies.description: Linda Hanson is told that her husband Jim has died in a car crash, only to wake the next morning and find him alive beside her. As the days of the same week begin arriving out of order, Linda tries to understand the pattern and determine whether the coming tragedy can be changed.

movies.title: Ratatouille
movies.description: Remy is a rat with an unusually refined sense of taste and a determination to cook, a disastrous ambition for an animal living above a Paris restaurant. He secretly partners with kitchen novice Linguini, whose career rises as long as nobody discovers who is really guiding the food.

movies.title: Remember Sunday
movies.description: Waitress Molly meets Gus, a gentle jewelry-store employee who seems interested in her but repeatedly forgets details they have already shared. She eventually learns that a brain injury prevents Gus from forming new long-term memories, making every step of their relationship something he must rediscover.

movies.title: Robot and Frank
movies.description: Frank, an aging former jewel thief whose memory is beginning to fail, is given a domestic robot by his worried son. Frank discovers that the machine's programming can be bent toward an old profession, and their unlikely partnership gives him both a new accomplice and a reason to stay engaged with life.

movies.title: Say Anything
movies.description: After graduation, easygoing Lloyd Dobler pursues Diane Court, the brilliant and sheltered class valedictorian everyone assumes is headed for a larger life. Their unexpectedly sincere relationship is tested by Diane's protective father and by the different futures waiting for them after summer.

movies.title: Scoop
movies.description: American journalism student Sondra Pransky receives a murder tip from the ghost of a dead reporter while visiting London. With anxious magician Sid Waterman pretending to be her father, she investigates charming aristocrat Peter Lyman and becomes inconveniently attracted to the man she is trying to prove is a killer.

movies.title: Secondhand Lions
movies.description: Shy teenager Walter is left for the summer with his eccentric great-uncles Hub and Garth, whose rumored fortune has attracted every grasping relative in sight. Their wild stories of travel, war and lost love gradually give Walter a model of adulthood far sturdier than the one he arrived with.

movies.title: Shades of Ray
movies.description: Ray Rehman is a half-Pakistani actor in Los Angeles who has just proposed to his longtime girlfriend when his estranged father moves in after leaving Ray's mother. Meeting a woman with a similarly mixed background makes Ray question both his relationship and the identity he has spent years simplifying.

movies.title: Signs
movies.description: Former minister Graham Hess discovers enormous crop circles in the fields around his Pennsylvania farmhouse just as similar formations appear around the world. As strange events close in on the isolated family, Graham is forced to confront both a possible extraterrestrial threat and the faith he abandoned after his wife's death.

movies.title: Six Days Seven Nights
movies.description: New York magazine editor Robin Monroe hires rough island pilot Quinn Harris for an emergency flight during a tropical vacation. A storm forces them down on an uninhabited island, where escaping the wilderness, pirates and each other's temperament becomes more complicated than either expected.

movies.title: Snow Bride
movies.description: Tabloid reporter Greta Kaine races to a wealthy family's snowy Christmas retreat hoping to uncover a rumored engagement before her rival does. Mistaken for a guest, she gets close to the Tannenhills and to eldest son Ben, making the story she came to exploit increasingly difficult to publish.

movies.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
movies.description: Working-class high-school senior Keith Nelson finally lands a date with popular Amanda Jones, despite the hostility of her wealthy ex-boyfriend. His tomboy best friend Watts helps him prepare for the evening while struggling with the fact that Keith is chasing someone else.

movies.title: Source Code
movies.description: Army pilot Colter Stevens repeatedly wakes inside the final eight minutes of a commuter train that has already been destroyed by a bomb. Each reset gives him another chance to identify the attacker, while fragments outside the simulation raise a more disturbing question about Colter's own condition.

movies.title: Spider-Man I
movies.description: Teenager Peter Parker gains extraordinary strength, agility and wall-crawling abilities after a genetically altered spider bite. Personal tragedy turns those powers into a responsibility, just as industrialist Norman Osborn becomes the violent Green Goblin and threatens the people Peter cares about most.

movies.title: Spider-Man II
movies.description: Peter Parker is exhausted by the conflict between ordinary life and the demands of being Spider-Man, while his relationships and studies begin to collapse. At the same time, scientist Otto Octavius is transformed by a failed experiment into a dangerous new opponent whose ambitions put the city at risk.

movies.title: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
movies.description: Wild stallion Spirit is captured by the U.S. Cavalry and refuses repeated attempts to break him. His bond with a Lakota man named Little Creek and mare Rain pulls him through captivity, railroad construction and a long fight to return to his herd.

movies.title: Star Trek: First Contact
movies.description: After the Borg attack Earth, Captain Picard disobeys orders and follows their sphere into the twenty-first century. The Enterprise crew must stop the Borg from preventing humanity's first warp flight and first contact with an alien civilization while Picard confronts how much the Borg still control his judgment.

movies.title: Star Trek Generations
movies.description: Captain Picard pursues scientist Tolian Soran, whose plan to re-enter a timeless energy ribbon will destroy an inhabited star system. The crisis eventually links Picard with retired Captain James T. Kirk, giving two generations of Enterprise captains a shared problem neither can solve alone.

movies.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
movies.description: While investigating Data's strange behavior on a peaceful planet, Captain Picard discovers that Starfleet officers are helping the Son'a secretly relocate the Ba'ku. The Enterprise crew must decide whether orders still deserve obedience when the mission itself violates the principles the Federation claims to defend.

movies.title: Star Trek: The Cage
movies.description: Captain Christopher Pike answers a distress call from Talos IV and finds survivors of an expedition lost years earlier. The apparent rescue is a trap set by powerful telepaths who imprison Pike and use elaborate illusions to test whether he and captive Vina can become the foundation of a human breeding colony.

movies.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
movies.description: A vast energy cloud moving toward Earth destroys everything in its path, forcing Admiral Kirk to take command of a newly refitted Enterprise before the ship or crew is fully ready. The object at the cloud's center turns the mission from interception into a confrontation with an intelligence seeking its creator.

movies.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
movies.description: After learning that Spock's living spirit may be trapped inside Dr. McCoy while his body lies on the unstable Genesis planet, Kirk defies Starfleet and steals the Enterprise. The rescue brings his crew into conflict with a Klingon commander who wants Genesis for himself.

movies.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
movies.description: An environmental disaster forces the Klingon Empire to seek peace with the Federation, but the negotiations are sabotaged by conspirators on both sides. Kirk and McCoy are framed for murder while Spock and the Enterprise crew race to expose the plot before a historic peace conference becomes another target.

movies.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
movies.description: A mysterious probe arrives at Earth and begins devastating the planet while transmitting a call no living species can answer. Kirk and his crew travel to 1986 San Francisco to find the humpback whales whose voices may be the only response the probe will accept.

movies.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
movies.description: Admiral Kirk's inspection of a training cruise becomes a personal battle when Khan Noonien Singh escapes exile and seizes a starship. Khan wants both the experimental Genesis device and revenge on Kirk, forcing the Enterprise into a contest of tactics with increasingly irreversible costs.

movies.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
movies.description: Farm boy Luke Skywalker is pulled into a galactic rebellion after two droids carry stolen plans for the Empire's planet-destroying Death Star to his home. With Obi-Wan Kenobi, Han Solo and Princess Leia, Luke joins a desperate attempt to deliver the plans and attack the station before it can destroy the rebel base.

movies.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
movies.description: After rescuing Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt, the Rebel Alliance prepares to destroy a second Death Star before it becomes fully operational. Luke Skywalker meanwhile confronts Darth Vader and Emperor Palpatine, convinced that the conflict with his father does not have to end the way the Emperor expects.

movies.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
movies.description: Driven from their base by the Empire, the Rebel Alliance scatters while Luke Skywalker travels to Dagobah to train with Jedi Master Yoda. Han, Leia and their companions flee Darth Vader across the galaxy, drawing Luke toward a confrontation that changes what he understands about his enemy and himself.

movies.title: Stargate
movies.description: Egyptologist Daniel Jackson deciphers an ancient device as a gateway to another planet, where Colonel Jack O'Neil leads a military expedition through it. On the far side they find a human civilization ruled by a being whose connection to ancient Egypt explains far more of Earth's past than anyone expected.

movies.title: Stealing Christmas
movies.description: Small-time thief Jack Clayton escapes a failed robbery wearing a Santa suit and is mistaken for the man hired to play Santa in a small town. Planning another bank job, he instead becomes involved with shop owner Sarah, her daughter and the community's Christmas traditions, making his old plan harder to carry through.

movies.title: Superman Returns
movies.description: After years away searching for remnants of Krypton, Superman returns to Earth and finds that Lois Lane has built a life without him. As he tries to understand his place in that life, Lex Luthor uses stolen Kryptonian technology to create a scheme that could reshape the planet at enormous human cost.

movies.title: Surprised by Love
movies.description: Businesswoman Josie wants her disapproving parents to accept polished boyfriend Richard, so Richard suggests using Josie's scruffy old flame Maxwell as a deliberately worse alternative. A weekend with the family backfires when Maxwell proves more genuine than expected and Josie begins reconsidering which relationship actually fits her.

movies.title: Tangled
movies.description: Rapunzel has spent her life locked in a hidden tower by Mother Gothel, who uses the girl's magical hair to preserve her own youth. When wanted thief Flynn Rider stumbles into the tower, Rapunzel makes him guide her to the floating lights she has watched every birthday and begins discovering who she really is.

movies.title: Team Bride
movies.description: Bridal-shop employee Hannah restores vintage wedding dresses on the side and hopes to build something of her own. When company heir Will is forced to work on the shop floor before taking over the family business, Hannah becomes his reluctant mentor and discovers that his ideas improve as he starts listening.

movies.title: The Abyss
movies.description: When a U.S. nuclear submarine sinks near a deep-sea oil platform, its civilian crew is drafted into a military recovery mission led by an increasingly unstable SEAL team. Engineer Bud Brigman and designer Lindsey Brigman soon realize that the disaster has also drawn the attention of something living far below them.

movies.title: The Adjustment Bureau
movies.description: Politician David Norris meets dancer Elise Sellas and feels an immediate connection, only to discover a hidden organization that insists their relationship is not part of the approved plan for either life. David decides that staying with Elise is worth challenging the people who quietly manage chance itself.

movies.title: The Age of Adaline
movies.description: After an unusual accident in 1937, Adaline Bowman stops aging and spends decades changing identities before anyone notices. Her carefully controlled solitude begins to fail when she falls for Ellis Jones and then meets someone in his family who recognizes the woman she was supposed to have left behind.

movies.title: The Blue Lagoon
movies.description: Children Richard and Emmeline survive a shipwreck and grow up together on an isolated tropical island with little guidance from the adult world. As childhood becomes adolescence, they must work out survival, intimacy, jealousy and parenthood largely by themselves.

movies.title: The Children’s Hour
movies.description: Teachers Karen Wright and Martha Dobie run a girls' boarding school until a malicious student invents a story about their relationship. The accusation spreads through the community, destroying the school and forcing both women to confront truths that rumor and respectability have made almost impossible to discuss.

movies.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
movies.description: Alien visitor Klaatu lands in Washington with a warning intended for every nation on Earth, but fear and military suspicion prevent him from delivering it. Escaping government custody, he lives anonymously among ordinary people while searching for a way to demonstrate that his message cannot simply be ignored.

movies.title: The Englishman Who Went Up a Hill
movies.description: Two English cartographers arrive in a Welsh village and declare that its beloved local mountain is a few feet too short to qualify as one. The villagers respond by organizing an improbable effort to raise the summit before the surveyors can leave, while one of the outsiders becomes increasingly attached to the place.

movies.title: The First Time
movies.description: Dave, a high-school senior stuck on a girl who sees him only as a friend, meets outspoken junior Aubrey outside a party. One long conversation becomes a relationship, and both discover that first love and first sex are considerably less tidy than the versions they have imagined.

movies.title: The Forty Four Hundred
movies.description: Exactly 4,400 people who vanished over many decades suddenly reappear together without having aged and with no memory of where they have been. Federal agents Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris investigate the returnees as unusual abilities begin emerging and the event starts changing families, institutions and the wider world.

movies.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
movies.description: Independent widow Lucy Muir moves with her daughter into a seaside cottage despite warnings that it is haunted. The ghost of its former owner, irascible sea captain Daniel Gregg, initially tries to drive her out but becomes an unexpected companion when Lucy refuses to be intimidated.

movies.title: The Greatest Game Ever Played
movies.description: Working-class amateur Francis Ouimet earns a place in the 1913 U.S. Open and finds himself competing against British champion Harry Vardon, a man who also rose from modest beginnings. The tournament becomes a test of talent, class assumptions and whether either man will be allowed to define himself by more than his origins.

movies.title: The Imitation Game
movies.description: Mathematician Alan Turing joins Britain's wartime effort to break Germany's Enigma cipher and pushes his team toward building a machine capable of finding patterns faster than people can. The secrecy surrounding that work later collides with a society prepared to prosecute Turing for his private life.

movies.title: The Iron Giant
movies.description: Young Hogarth Hughes discovers a gigantic robot that has fallen from space into rural Maine and secretly teaches it about language, friendship and choice. Their bond is threatened when a suspicious federal agent becomes convinced the machine is a weapon and brings the military closer to the town.

movies.title: The Island
movies.description: Lincoln Six Echo lives in a sealed facility whose residents are told the outside world is contaminated and that a lottery can send them to a safe island. His curiosity reveals that the facility's purpose is very different from what its residents believe, forcing Lincoln and Jordan Two Delta to escape into a world they were never meant to see.

movies.title: The Lake House
movies.description: Doctor Kate Forster leaves a note for the next tenant of a glass lake house and receives a reply from architect Alex Wyler, only to discover that he is living there two years earlier. Their correspondence grows into a relationship conducted through a mailbox that connects different points in time.

movies.title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
movies.description: Journalist Ellie Haworth discovers a cache of passionate letters describing a secret affair in the 1960s and becomes determined to learn what happened to the lovers. Her investigation reconstructs Jennifer Stirling's hidden relationship with reporter Anthony O'Hare while unsettling Ellie's own assumptions about love and risk.

movies.title: The Man from Earth
movies.description: University professor John Oldman abruptly resigns and gathers colleagues at his cabin before leaving town. Pressed to explain himself, he claims he has lived continuously since prehistoric times, turning an informal farewell into an increasingly serious examination of history, belief and whether such a story could be disproved.

movies.title: The Most Colorful Time of the Year
movies.description: Optometrist Michelle discovers that her daughter's science teacher Ryan is color-blind and persuades him to try new corrective glasses during the Christmas season. Seeing familiar surroundings in a radically different way brings Ryan closer to Michelle and her daughter as his guarded routine begins to loosen.

movies.title: The Notebook
movies.description: In a nursing home, an elderly man reads a love story about working-class Noah Calhoun and wealthy Allie Hamilton, who fall for each other during a summer in the 1940s. Family pressure and war separate them, but the unfinished relationship returns years later when Allie is preparing to marry someone else.

movies.title: The Phantom of the Opera
movies.description: Young soprano Christine Daaé rises at the Paris Opera under the secret guidance of a masked musical genius living beneath the building. His possessive devotion turns dangerous when Christine renews her bond with Raoul and the Phantom begins forcing the opera company to serve his private vision.

movies.title: The Princess and the Marine
movies.description: U.S. Marine Jason Johnson and Bahraini royal Meriam Al-Khalifa fall in love despite family, religious and political barriers that make an ordinary courtship impossible. Their attempt to leave Bahrain together turns a private relationship into an international dispute with consequences neither can control.

movies.title: The Soulmate Search
movies.description: Artist Ellen joins exclusive matchmaking service Eternity and is horrified to be paired with Will, the lawyer who criticized her work earlier that day. Convinced the supposedly perfect service has failed, they team up to demand a refund and spend enough time together to complicate their argument.

movies.title: The Sure Thing
movies.description: College freshman Gib travels across the country toward California after a friend promises him a guaranteed romantic encounter. His ride pairs him with disciplined classmate Alison, and a string of travel disasters gradually makes the destination less important than the person he cannot stop arguing with.

movies.title: The Terminator
movies.description: A cybernetic assassin is sent from a machine-dominated future to 1984 Los Angeles to kill Sarah Connor before she can become the mother of resistance leader John Connor. Soldier Kyle Reese follows to protect her, turning an ordinary woman's life into a relentless fight against an enemy that does not tire or negotiate.

movies.title: The Time Traveler’s Wife
movies.description: Librarian Henry DeTamble has a genetic condition that causes him to disappear unpredictably into different moments of his own life. His relationship with Clare Abshire therefore unfolds out of sequence, forcing both of them to build a marriage around absences, foreknowledge and events neither can reliably prevent.

movies.title: The Vow
movies.description: Newlyweds Leo and Paige survive a car crash, but Paige awakens with no memory of their relationship or the life she built after leaving her wealthy family. Leo tries to help her fall in love with him again while Paige confronts a version of herself that now feels like someone else's biography.

movies.title: The X-Files
movies.description: FBI agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully investigate a bombing that appears to conceal evidence of a much larger conspiracy involving an extraterrestrial virus. Their search takes them from Texas to Antarctica as they discover how far the people managing the secret are willing to go to keep it buried.

movies.title: Timeless Love
movies.description: Megan wakes from a coma grieving a husband and two children who turn out to have existed only in the life she experienced while unconscious. Trying to move forward, she starts a new job and meets Thomas, the exact man she remembers as her husband, except he has never met her.

movies.title: Un Plan Parfait
movies.description: Isabelle believes the women in her family are cursed to have disastrous first marriages, so she plans to marry and quickly divorce a stranger before wedding the man she actually loves. Her chosen victim, eccentric travel writer Jean-Yves, proves much harder to treat as a disposable technicality.

movies.title: Waiting for Forever
movies.description: Actress Emma returns to her hometown because her father is seriously ill and discovers that childhood friend Will has built his wandering life around an idealized devotion to her. Their reunion forces Will's romantic certainty into contact with Emma's actual life, family and choices.

movies.title: WALL-E
movies.description: Long after humanity abandoned a trash-covered Earth, compacting robot WALL-E continues working alone and collecting curious remnants of human life. The arrival of sleek probe EVE gives him a companion and a purpose that eventually carries both robots to the ship where the human population has been waiting to return.

movies.title: Wallace and Gromit
movies.description: Wallace and Gromit run a humane pest-control service just as the village prepares for its giant vegetable competition. Wallace's attempt to cure rabbits of their appetite goes spectacularly wrong, leaving the pair to hunt a mysterious creature that is destroying gardens across the neighborhood.

movies.title: When Love Springs
movies.description: Public-relations professional Rory returns to a country inn for her parents' vow renewal and unexpectedly encounters an ex she would rather impress than explain. She persuades innkeeper Noah to pose as her boyfriend while she helps promote his struggling business, and the arrangement soon becomes less fictional than intended.

movies.title: When We First Met
movies.description: Noah believes the night he met Avery should have made them a couple, but three years later she is engaged to someone else. A magical photo booth repeatedly sends him back to that first evening, letting him rewrite the encounter until he finally understands which parts of his desired future are actually wrong.

movies.title: White Collar
movies.description: Brilliant con artist Neal Caffrey escapes prison to search for the woman he loves, only to be recaptured by FBI agent Peter Burke. Neal bargains for supervised release as Peter's consultant, turning the hunter and fugitive into an uneasy team solving sophisticated white-collar crimes.

movies.title: Wicker Park
movies.description: Advertising executive Matthew sees a woman in a restaurant whom he believes is Lisa, the girlfriend who vanished from his life two years earlier. His attempt to find her pulls him through overlapping apartments, messages and relationships, gradually revealing that the disappearance was not as simple as either abandonment or coincidence.

movies.title: Win a Date with Tad Hamilton
movies.description: Small-town grocery clerk Rosalee wins a publicity contest for a date with movie star Tad Hamilton, and the actor unexpectedly keeps pursuing her afterward. Her best friend Pete, who has loved Rosalee quietly for years, must decide whether to keep waiting or finally make his feelings impossible to miss.

movies.title: Wonder Woman
movies.description: Amazon princess Diana leaves her hidden island after rescuing American pilot Steve Trevor and learning of the war consuming the outside world. Convinced an ancient enemy is driving the conflict, she joins Steve's mission and discovers that human violence is more complicated than the explanation she was raised to expect.

movies.title: You’ve Got Mail
movies.description: Independent bookseller Kathleen Kelly and chain-store executive Joe Fox become enemies when his new megastore threatens her neighborhood shop. Neither realizes that they are also the anonymous email correspondents whose increasingly personal messages have become the most honest relationship in either life.
